bootstrapCommands: curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.15.0/node-v24.15.0-linux-x64.tar.xz -o /tmp/node.tar.xz && echo '472655581fb851559730c48763e0c9d3bc25975c59d518003fc0849d3e4ba0f6  /tmp/node.tar.xz' | sha256sum -c - && rm -rf /opt/node && mkdir -p /opt/node && tar -xJf /tmp/node.tar.xz -C /opt/node --strip-components=1 && /opt/node/bin/node --version && PATH=/opt/node/bin:$PATH /opt/node/bin/npm --version

agent.systemPrompt: You are a precise senior coding agent. Respect scope exactly. Prefer the smallest correct change. Output strict JSON only.
agent.taskPrompt: Fix GitHub issue Marthijs-Berfelo/buddy-harmony#482 at this exact immutable commit. Runtime evidence is the source of truth: /scale has exactly six buttons; four are unnamed (menu/hamburger, language selector, settings gear, print), while Key and Scale already have accessible names and MUST stay unchanged. Add localized accessible names through the existing i18n structure. react-flags-select renders its own button and its props do not accept aria-label, so solve that without changing the dependency or visual layout. Only edit allowlisted files. Preserve behavior and visuals. Match repository Prettier/ESLint formatting exactly; lint permits zero warnings.

preview.finalCommand: export PATH=/opt/node/bin:$PATH; export __VITE_ADDITIONAL_SERVER_ALLOWED_HOSTS=.preview.getsolari.com; npm run preview -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4173 --base /

analysis.method: pstack runtime-first blast-radius: issue text is a hypothesis; the running app is the source of truth
analysis.hypothesis: Issue #482 correctly reports four unnamed controls but its affected-element list is stale: Key/Scale may already be named and the menu button may be the actual fourth failure
analysis.safetyInvariant: Only eight allowlisted source/i18n files may change; six buttons remain six; existing Key and Scale names remain; the screenshot stays visually identical while unnamed buttons go 4 -> 0
